title: The Swim to the Flat Rock

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: A group of teenagers decides to swim out to a flat rock in the lagoon, and one of them is a much weaker swimmer.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A group of teenagers decides to swim out to a flat rock in the lagoon, and one of them is a much weaker swimmer.

choices.label: Let the Swimmer Decide Without Pressure.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Halfway there, the swimmer turns back, and the friend returns with them without complaint.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The log gives everyone a place to rest, and the swim becomes a game.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The log drifts away, and the group spends the afternoon chasing it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Everyone enjoys the shorter swim, and nobody feels left out.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some grumble, but they agree to try the far rock another day.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The swimmer chooses to try, and the others swim slowly beside them.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: Both reach the rock, and the weaker swimmer feels proud.
